notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch and headless Playwright both returned a DataDome CAPTCHA challenge page site-wide (including robots.txt) - both tier-1 and tier-2 access were genuinely blocked. Escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3); robots.txt (fetched via the connector) shows User-agent:* Allow:/ with no Claude-specific disallow, so proceeding was permitted. Discovery performed: (1) the persistent 'Shop by Category' dropdown on /home and on the Home Decor subcategory page (/apartment-room-decor) - neither lists any Christmas/Halloween/Holiday/seasonal entry, only evergreen categories (Bedding, Furniture, Home Decor, Candles + Home Fragrance, Kitchen + Dining, Lighting, Wall Art, Rugs, Bath, Storage + Organization, etc.); (2) main nav mega-menu inspected via accessibility tree - no dedicated Christmas/Halloween/holiday nav link exists site-wide; (3) site search run for christmas, christmas gifts, christmas decor, halloween, halloween decor, easter, thanksgiving, diwali (0 results, confirming real absence), stocking, fall decor; 'fall decor' returned 3999 products (a non-discriminating default dump - confirmed as the known search-trap per rules and rejected as evidence); (4) the /gifts hub page's 'Holiday Gifts' block is editorial text only with no PLP link; its 'Valentine's Day gifts' link and the 'christmas' search page's 'Holiday Decor' and 'Stocking Stuffers' quick-links resolved to real PLPs, checked below. Genuine findings: 'Holiday Decor + Party Supplies' (/holiday-party-decorations-supplies) is a real, Home-scoped PLP (no Department facet appears on it, i.e. already Home-only) with exact count 2; site names it generically 'Holiday' but its own description (garland, ornaments, character stockings, 'winter wonderland') unambiguously identifies it as Christmas, so category is recorded as Christmas rather than flagged. 'Halloween' (/halloween, 145 products) and the un-filtered 'Valentine's Day Gifts' (/valentines-day-gifts, 48 products) and 'Stocking Stuffers + Gifts' (/stocking-stuffers, 58 products) are general store-wide occasion pages mixing apparel/beauty/lingerie across all departments, out of scope for the Home company - each was re-checked with the site's own Department=Home facet: Halloween?department=Home returns 0 products ('no products match the filters'), confirming no genuine Halloween home-decor category exists; Valentine's Day Gifts?department=Home returns 14 Home-department products (throw pillows, duvet cover, tablecloth, picture frame, trinket box, window panel) with its own clean facet URL and exact count, recorded as a row; Stocking Stuffers?department=Home returns 6 Home-department products, also recorded (flagged for holiday-attribution review since the site's own copy does not explicitly say Christmas/holiday for that page, only the traditional English association of 'stocking' with Christmas). No Diwali, Easter, Thanksgiving, New Year, or other festival category exists anywhere on the site (US-only retailer, all searches returned 0 or non-discriminating generic results). Two browser tabs used for this extraction were closed on completion.
